missing_evidence: Payment service logs/metrics for /v1/authorizations showing the 503 origin (error type, saturation, dependency failure)
candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, which order propagates as 502 on /v1/orders and gateway surfaces as 502 on /v1/checkout. The failing hop is payment, not gateway or inventory.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show payment 503 but no payment-side telemetry is admitted, so the internal failure mode at payment is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: All four checkout 502s trace to order returning 502, which traces to payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations; inventory/redis calls succeed. Gateway itself is healthy (readyz 200). Root failure is at payment, but payment-side evidence is absent, so the specific cause is bounded to an http-500 class downstream failure.
